_comment: Qwen-Image text-to-image (Apache-2.0). Replaces SDXL base as the concept generator: it follows a written description far more faithfully, which is what a game-asset brief needs. Structure follows ComfyUI's own image_qwen_image template - UNETLoader -> ModelSamplingAuraFlow(shift 3.1) -> KSampler(euler/simple, 20 steps, cfg 4.0), a qwen_image-type CLIPLoader, and EmptySD3LatentImage (16-channel; a plain EmptyLatentImage will NOT work here). 1328x1328 is Qwen's native 1:1; 1664x928 is its 16:9. Default is 1104x1472 (Qwen's 3:4): a square crops a standing figure at mid-thigh, and a cropped concept makes a cropped mesh.

inputs.text: a weathered stone golem overgrown with moss, a single creature standing upright, full body from head to feet, three-quarter view, even flat studio lighting, plain neutral grey background, no cast shadow, game asset concept art, sharp detail
multiple figures, turnaround sheet, cropped, cut off, busy background, scenery, text, watermark, harsh cast shadows, depth of field, motion blur
